entries.message: Fix - Stop non-release commits from polluting changelog entries
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fixed a real problem: the v0.8.6 release notes were dumping bullets from a chore commit (an internal debug-only endpoint) and a test commit (fixing test expectations) into the same entry as real feature and bug-fix work, making Settings -> Changelog read like a raw commit log instead of release notes

The changelog generator now only backfills bullets from commits typed feat, fix, security, enhance, perf, or docs - a chore/test/refactor/style/ci commit bundled into the same push never contributes its own bullets, even when it isn't otherwise CI plumbing
Applies to both the main and alpha changelog generators, which share the same filtering logic
Manually cleaned the noise already published in the current v0.8.6 and v0.8.3 entries so what's live in Settings -> Changelog reads correctly now, not just for future releases

Also removed one bullet that was pure investigation narration with no resulting product change (a bug report that turned out to be a stale session, not a code fix) - the type filter can't catch this since it lived inside an otherwise legitimate feature commit
